verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents API access for core operational tasks—receiving customer requests via API (docs-13, docs-20) and running the Internal Agent's automations via API (docs-14, docs-22)—and a live API reference exists (parahelp-probe-rt-2). However, no evidence shows that configuration authoring, simulation/testing, release management, or knowledge-diff review (all UI-centric per docs-1/2/4/9) can be done via API, and no discoverable OpenAPI spec was found (parahelp-probe-2 shows 404s across standard paths). Missing for 10: API parity for configuration/build workflows, testing/simulation via API, release/rollback via API, formal OpenAPI spec confirming full surface coverage.
